data.one_liner: Plugin to open local files with native apps across Android, iOS, web, desktop
data.what_it_does: It launches the appropriate native application to view or edit a file given its path. Supports custom MIME types and handles platform-specific permissions.
use_when: Need to open documents from a Flutter app
Want to delegate file handling to the device’s default apps
avoid_when: You need to edit files within the app
You require full control over file rendering
strengths: Handles many file types out of the box
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, configure Android FileProvider and permissions, iOS UTI setup may be needed
